name: EchoOut
description: DJ Echo Out throw. Touch mutes the dry instantly and leaves a tempo-synced echo; lift keeps the wet decaying until it dies. X = delay note, Y = how fast the feedback falls after release.

params.name: FALL
params.detail: How fast feedback dies after release

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Wet level of the thrown echo

params.name: FB
params.detail: Feedback while the pad is held
